subject: Trial kickoff: ownership, success metrics, and sprint checkpoints
messages:
From: Ben Sachs <ben.sachs@acmecorp.com>
To: jonas_weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 23 May 2027 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Trial kickoff: ownership, success metrics, and sprint checkpoints

Thanks for the call this morning — good to meet the team. To recap from ACME's side and to make sure we start the trial on the same page: we want a short, timeboxed proof (4 weeks) to validate two things:

1) Integration + stability: can we serve a subset of production traffic (internal pilot) through Redwood with no more than 5% error rate and < 250ms p95 inference latency for our 1k-token average prompts.
2) Cost and throughput: can the solution sustain our expected burst (up to 30 req/s) and keep incremental inference cost within a target we can use for sizing.

Next steps / asks from ACME:
- Please confirm owners for infra, app integration, security review, and procurement.
- Provide a proposed week-by-week cadence and what success sign-offs look like.
- Procurement contact and estimated lead time for PO/contract.

Attached is a simple internal roadmap we sketched out — it shows the three trial slices we care about (ingest, inference, validation).

Ben
Director, Platform Engineering
ACME Corp

Attachment: Acme-PoC-Roadmap.xlsx (spreadsheet stub; 1 tab: goals & checkpoints)

From: jonas_weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Sachs <ben.sachs@acmecorp.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, stephanie_nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 24 May 2027 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Trial kickoff: ownership, success metrics, and sprint checkpoints

Ben — appreciate the clear framing. Short answer: we can run a 4-week pilot and we'll propose a playbook that maps owners and acceptance gates. High level plan attached (Redwood PoC template).

Quick owner assignments (proposed):
- Infra (network, capacity, PCRs): kimberly_park (Redwood Dedicated/Private lead)
- App integration (SDKs, routing, test harness): karthik_iyer (Solutions Eng)
- Security & compliance review (data isolation, retention): stephanie_nguyen (Security PM)
- Redwood trial coordinator & SLO sign-off: jonas_weber (Sales lead)

Suggested 4-week cadence (week-by-week):
Week 0 (prep, ~3 business days): contract/PO path confirmed; infra provisioning; test keys & sample dataset exchange.
Week 1 (integration): deploy and smoke test integration with sandbox traffic; confirm p95 baseline for your 1k-token median.
Week 2 (scale & tuning): run sustained load up to 30 req/s; tuning (batching, KV cache) to meet cost/latency bands.
Week 3 (validation & evals): run ACME evaluation prompts and success suites; run regressions vs baseline.
Final 3 days (handoff & sign-off): compile results, produce runbook and recommendations.

Proposed success metrics (example, happy to refine):
- Availability: >= 99% across trial window
- Error rate: <= 5% (per your ask)
- Latency: p95 <= 250ms on trimmed set (1k-token typical)
- Inference incremental cost: estimate target threshold (we'll produce detailed cost calc)

We will need procurement contact and PO timing to lock the Week 0 start. Also, Laura at ProcureOps was mentioned — looping her in would be great.

Attaching: redwood-poc-template.pdf (trial checklist and RACI table).

Onwards — I will follow up with a short RACI doc + a one-page evaluation plan by tomorrow.

Cheers,
Jonas Weber
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood-poc-template.pdf (1-page checklist + RACI)

Jonas / Ben — looping in procurement. A couple items from procurement side that affect Week 0 timing:
- Standard PO -> contract turnaround is typically 7–10 business days once terms are agreed; if we need an expedited path we can do an MSA + PO; I need Redwood's standard MSA (or a reference DocuSign link).
- We need clarity on data retention / deletion for sandbox data (ACME will not allow vendor storage beyond 90 days without a retention policy).
- Finance will require a line-item estimate for expected spend during pilot (ballpark is fine to start).

Happy to set a 30-minute procurement + legal sync if that helps. Attaching our checklist.

Laura Zhen
Head of Vendor Ops, ProcureOps (ACME procurement partner)

From: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Sachs <ben.sachs@acmecorp.com>, jonas_weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, stephanie_nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 25 May 2027 09:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Trial kickoff: ownership, success metrics, and sprint checkpoints

Ben / Jonas / team — thanks. Quick confirmation from engineering side and a short checklist to operationalize:

Confirmed owners (finalized):
- Infra provisioning & capacity tuning: kimberly_park (Redwood Dedicated/Private) — contact kimberly_park@redwood.ai
- Integration & SDK tests: karthik_iyer (Solutions Eng) — I'll own the SDK handoff, CI job, and baseline harness.
- Security review & audit evidence: stephanie_nguyen (Security PM) — will queue an SOC-2 scoping note and data retention policy.
- Procurement & contracting liaison: Laura Zhen / ProcureOps (cc'd).

Concrete next steps (short checklist):
1) Procurement & MSA: Jonas to share Redwood's standard MSA link / DocuSign. (Owner: jonas_weber; Due: EOD Wed)
2) Exchange sample prompt set + 10 anonymized records for validation. (Owner: ben.sachs@acmecorp.com; Due: Fri)
3) Infra provisioning request: kimberly to allocate a 1-GPU test node pool and a 2-GPU burst pool. (Owner: kimberly_park; Due: End of Week 0)
4) Baseline run & smoke: karthik will run a baseline harness and return p50/p95 metrics and a cost estimate per 1k tokens. (Owner: karthik_iyer; Due: End of Week 1)
5) Acceptance run & report: run evaluation suite and produce sign-off doc. (Owner: jonas_weber + ACME eng; Due: End of Week 3)

Example acceptance gate (we'll formalize into a checklist):
- p95 latency <= 250ms on trimmed workload (1k typical)
- Max error rate during validation windows <= 5%
- Throughput plateau achieved at 30 req/s without steady-state queueing/backpressure

Cost note: we'll provide a conservative incremental cost estimate for the trial based on the baseline run. Our Optimize team will recommend batching/tuning options to hit your cost target.

I'll follow up with a short RACI table embedded in the PoC doc once the procurement timing is resolved.

-Karthik
Principal Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
